searchText: EIP-1898 change to Review - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6309 note that i) I don't recommend pushing forward JSON-RPC eips at this point, we've mostly switched over to `execution-apis` now and ii) I removed the object parameter from the methods so now they only support a hex integer, block tag, or hex block hash
